fusions.name: Herd Guard Jab
fusions.desc: A jab that deals 4 damage, up to 1.2 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% for each ally beside you, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Alarm Musk
fusions.desc: Releases an alarm scent in a burst that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Flank
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and raises your armour by 5% for 8 seconds. An escort of stingers fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Hollow
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you regain 3 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
